Backend: new pytest suite (9 tests, 9 passed) covering sample gaji_trial.xlsx import (3 slips: Wawan/Harjono/Rahmat), dynamic rate-block parsing (slip['rates'] contains Perhari/Lembur/T. Kehadiran/T. Transport; legacy t_transport=10000), Rahmat PDF text contains 'T. Transport' twice + 'Perhari'/'Lembur/Jam'/'T. Kehadiran'/'10.000', PDFs for the other 2 slips render OK, and POST /api/hrd/payslips/bulk-delete (subset delete keeps rest, empty/unknown ids -> deleted 0, PIN gate 403, unauthenticated 401/403, single delete regression). Frontend: logged in as herliana, unlocked Data Gaji with PIN 1234, period Juli 2026 — select-all + 3 per-row checkboxes render, 'Hapus Terpilih (3)' appears only when rows selected, count updates to (2) after unchecking one, confirm dialog deletes exactly the 2 selected (toast '2 slip dihapus') keeping 1, single-row delete works, Template button works, UI Excel upload (hrd-import-input) re-created 3 slips with no console errors and no 4xx/5xx API calls, and per-row PDF download succeeded (SlipGaji_Rahmat_Ari_Sandi_NST.pdf). Test data cleaned up (Juli 2026 now empty).

minor.issue: Non-atomic: loops ids sequentially and _assert_slip_scope raises HTTPException mid-loop, so an out-of-group id causes a 403 AFTER some slips were already soft-deleted and the client gets no 'deleted' count. Prefer validating all ids first (or skipping out-of-scope ids) before deleting.
No cap on ids length — a huge list triggers N sequential find_one+update round-trips. Consider a bounded list (e.g. max 500) and a single bulk update_many on the scoped filter.

issues: Select-all checkbox has no indeterminate state: with 2 of 3 rows checked the header checkbox renders fully unchecked (data-testid='hrd-slip-checkall'). Minor UX polish.
React a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' (hrd-gajipin-dialog). Add DialogDescription.

action_items: Optional: make bulk-delete scope validation happen before any deletion (avoid partial delete + 403).
Optional: indeterminate state for hrd-slip-checkall when partially selected.
Optional: add DialogDescription to the PIN Gaji dialog to clear the a11y warning.

Pre-existing (unrelated): /app/backend/tests/test_boss_payroll_multigroup.py still hardcodes a stale fallback preview URL; /app/backend/tests/test_payroll_isolation.py 'nofia' tests error because user nofia does not exist in this environment (5 errors/1 failure). Either seed nofia or skip those tests.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/hrd.py is 1531 lines — split payroll (parse/PDF/import) into its own module for maintainability.

Dynamic rate parsing looks correct: rate_end is derived from the 'PENGHASILAN' row in column A (fallback 12) and skips PENGHASILAN/PENGURANGAN labels; _render_slip_pdf falls back to legacy perhari/lembur_jam/tkehadiran_rate/t_transport for old slips, so old data still renders.

Installed missing dev dep pypdf==6.15.0 into /root/.venv (it was in requirements.txt but absent from the venv) — PDF text assertions use pymupdf (fitz) which was already present. Worth confirming requirements are fully installed in the runtime image.
